Caustic Band.notes: +2 acid per weapon attack. Works on unarmed in practice (engine treats unarmed_attack_hit separately; this rider uses weapon_attack_hit so it does NOT fire on unarmed — see Unarmed Caustic override note).

Broodmother's Revenge.notes: Amulet: when healed, weapon coated, +1d6 poison. Self_healed_recently flag set by build.

Hex.notes: Concentration spell; +1d6 necrotic per attack vs hexed target.

Hunter's Mark.notes: Does NOT trigger on unarmed attacks (bg3.wiki exception). Uses weapon triggers only.

Lightning Charges.notes: +1 Lightning per damage source (flat DR). bg3.wiki Damage_mechanics worked example uses this exact +1 flat value. Patch 3 downgraded Lightning Charges from DRS to DR (it is now a plain Damage Rider, NOT a damage source).

Lightning Jabber.notes: Throwing: Lightning Damage passive — +1d4 Lightning as a NEW damage source (re-triggers all DRs). Thrown-only. This is the DRS in the bg3.wiki Damage_mechanics worked example.

Nyrulna.notes: Zephyr Connection: thrown-only 3d4 Thunder explosion as a new damage source. Wiki: this damage does NOT benefit from many riders that apply to the base weapon attack (engine flag exclude_from_most_riders — v1 approximation: still re-triggers DRs; honour_mode downgrades to DR).

Tavern Brawler (unarmed).notes: Adds Str mod to unarmed damage a second time. Granted by the Tavern Brawler feat.

Tavern Brawler (thrown).notes: Adds Str mod to thrown weapon damage again, and grants proficiency.

Bloodthirst.notes: Improved Critical: reduces crit threshold by 1 (crit on 19-20).
Exploit Weakness (main hand only): creatures hit with this weapon receive Vulnerability to Piercing damage. Applied to target at build setup (same mechanism as Bhaalist Armour).

Rage (Barbarian).notes: flat_sym rage_damage scales with barbarian level (2/3/4/5...). Type inherits weapon type. Self also grants resistance to bludgeoning/piercing/slashing (modeled in conditions).

Sneak Attack.notes: Scales 1d6 per 2 rogue levels (1d6@1,2d6@3,...). once_per_turn: round orchestrator routes to first eligible attack. Dice count overridden by rogue level at character layer.

Divine Smite.notes: An added damage SOURCE (DRS) declared per-attack via the build's smite action. +1d8 vs fiend/undead. Slot level scales dice (2d8@slot1, +1d8/slot, cap 5d8). round._build_smite_drs reads this entry and overrides the dice count by slot level. (Legacy kind 'DS_added' is treated as DRS by the engine.)

Great Weapon Master (active).notes: Toggleable: -5 attack roll, +10 damage on melee weapon attacks with heavy weapons.

Sharpshooter (active).notes: Toggleable: -5 attack, +10 damage on ranged weapon attacks.

Bhaalist Armour (Aura of Murder).notes: Enemies within 3m become Vulnerable to Piercing. Applied to target at build setup.

Savage Attacker.notes: SPECIAL PATH — NOT consumed as a normal rider. Detected by Character.has_savage_attacker() (feat name match) and applied in build_base_ds(savage=True), which adds the reroll-keep-higher EV to the weapon dice via dice.upgrade_savage(). Kept here only as a documented data pointer; do not add damage fields. Crit-doubling of the savage bonus is approximated away in v1 (non-crit majority is exact).

Symbiotic Entity.notes: Spore Druid Symbiotic Entity: +1d6 necrotic per weapon/unarmed attack while active. Granted by Symbiotic Entity action.

Craterflesh Gloves.notes: On critical hit, +1d6 Force. bg3.wiki Critical_hit: this added damage die is itself doubled by the crit (so crit adds 2d6 Force). Engine applies it only on the crit branch and doubles its dice.

Sword of Life Stealing.notes: On crit (this weapon only — wiki bug note: passive fires only on this sword's crits despite wording), +10 Necrotic (flat, NOT doubled by crit) and 10 temp HP. Engine: flat on_crit rider, no dice doubling. Excludes constructs/undead.

Hellfire Greataxe.notes: Hellflame Cleave weapon action: deals Hellfire Fire damage that IGNORES Fire resistance and immunity (bg3.wiki). Engine: DRS with bypass_resistance=true -> skips res/imm, vulnerability still applies. Wiki: this weapon action counts as a spell (benefits from spell-bonus effects); v1 models it as a melee DRS.

Colossus Slayer.notes: Hunter (Lv3) Colossus Slayer: once per turn, if target below max HP, weapon attack +1d8 Physical (wiki: Physical type, type-inherits via SameAsWeapon here). Wiki: it is a DRS (new damage source) and can apply to each damage source of the triggering attack. Engine: DRS, once_per_turn, condition target_le_full_hp (build sets the flag).

Lifedrinker.notes: Warlock (Lv12) Lifedrinker: melee attacks deal +Charisma modifier Necrotic. flat_sym cha_mod resolved from the build's CHA. DR (fires once per damage source).

Crimson Mischief.notes: Redvein Savagery (main hand only): when attacking with Advantage, target takes +7 Piercing (flat). Wiki: 'Damage rider as source damage' -> DRS, but applies to most damage sources of the base attack, NOT to some DRS (e.g. Colossus Slayer). Engine v1: DRS, condition attacker_has_advantage (build sets flag when advantage active). Also has Prey Upon the Weak (+1d4 Piercing vs <=50% HP, off-hand) — separate rider not modelled here.

Balduran's Giantslayer.notes: Topple the Big Folk weapon action: +proficiency bonus damage.

Giantslayer passive: on hit, double the damage from Strength. +str_mod Slashing (base DS already has str_mod once; this adds it again). Wiki also: vs Large+ +2d6 Slashing (in riders.auto.json) + Advantage.

Duellist's Prerogative.notes: Elegant Duellist: while off-hand empty, score a crit on 19. Build sets off_hand_empty flag.
Withering Cut (main hand only, bonus action): on melee hit, +proficiency bonus Necrotic.

The Clover.notes: Organ Rearranger: crit threshold reduced by 1 (crit on 19).
Exploit Weakness (main hand): creatures hit receive Vulnerability to Piercing.

Shar's Spear of Evening.notes: Shar's Blessing: +1d6 damage to Lightly/Heavily Obscured creatures. Build sets target_obscured flag.

Enlarge (Duergar).notes: Duergar racial Enlarge: weapons deal +1d4 damage (type follows weapon) for 10 turns. Racial version: once per Long Rest, NO concentration (Patch 3). Granted by Duergar Magic at level 3. Declare as active_buff in the build while enlarged.

Searing Smite (Zariel).notes: Zariel Tiefling racial Searing Smite (cast as 2nd-level slot at char level 3). On melee weapon hit: +1d6 Fire as a NEW damage source (DRS — bg3.wiki Damage_mechanics: weapon damage and extra fire are separate sources, spell-bonus rides weapon riders). Plus ongoing 1d6 Fire/turn until CON save (not modelled as per-turn here). Declare as active_buff. Upcast +1d6/level.

Agonizing Blast.notes: Warlock Eldritch Invocation: Eldritch Blast beams deal +Charisma modifier Force. Declare as active_buff (Warlock 2+). Trigger spell_attack_hit so it applies to each EB beam (each beam is a separate source).

Draconic Bloodline.notes: Sorcerer Draconic Bloodline (L1/L6) Elemental Affinity: when a spell deals damage of the ancestry element, +Charisma modifier. Build sets draconic_affinity_type flag (e.g. draconic_affinity_type:Fire) AND the spell's source type must match — engine simplification: applies to all spell damage while flag set; declare ancestry via active_buff 'Draconic Bloodline (Fire)' and set target flag matching the spell's type.

Empowered Evocation.notes: Wizard Evocation subclass L10: add Intelligence modifier to damage of Evocation spells. Auto-injected when subclass:Evocation and Wizard>=10. Engine simplification: applies to all spell damage (not just Evocation school).

Charger (charge).notes: Charger feat: a Charge weapon attack (Action+Bonus Action, move up to 9m) deals +5 damage. Declare as active_buff on the round the character charges; applies +5 flat to that melee attack's DS.

Martial Adept (superiority die).notes: Martial Adept feat: 1 Superiority Die (d8) per short rest, spent on a Battle Master manoeuvre (e.g. Menacing/Trip/Disarming) that adds +1d8 to a weapon attack's damage. Declare as active_buff when the die is spent. Type inherits weapon type (manoeuvre bonus is physical).

Gloves of the Balanced Hands.notes: Off-hand attack: add Ability Score Modifier to damage (Two-Weapon Fighting style). Build sets off_hand_attack flag on the off-hand attack action.

Shadow-Cloaked Ring.notes: +1d4 weapon/unarmed damage vs Lightly or Heavily Obscured targets. condition target_obscured (build flag).

Legacy of the Masters.notes: Arming Enhancement: +2 to attack AND damage rolls with weapons. (active when equipped.)

Circlet of Hunting.notes: +1d4 to Attack Rolls vs creatures marked by Hunter's Mark/True Strike/Faerie Fire/Guiding Bolt. Build sets target_marked flag. Engine: attack_bonus_dice adds a d4 to the attack roll (see character.attack_bonus).

Sarevok's Horned Helmet.notes: Deathbringer's Sight: crit threshold reduced by 1 (unconditional, stacks).

Bonespike Gloves.notes: Exoskeletal Reinforcement: your attacks ignore Resistance to Slashing/Piercing/Bludgeoning. Engine: marks physical damage as bypass_resistance.

Poisoner's Ring.notes: Virulent Venom: action to make a target Vulnerable to Poison (save negates). Modelled as target_vulnerability when build declares the ring used.

Necklace of Elemental Augmentation.notes: When a cantrip deals Acid/Cold/Fire/Lightning/Thunder damage, add spellcasting modifier to that damage. flat_sym spellcasting_mod; condition cantrip (build flag). _rider_type SameAsSpell resolves to the spell damage type. (wiki: cantrips only; engine applies to all spells as a simplification since spell-level tagging is not modelled.)

Hat of the Sharp Caster.notes: SPECIAL PATH (not consumed as normal rider). When a spell attack damage die rolls 1 or 2, reroll once keep higher. Approximated by adding upgrade_savage-style EV to spell-attack dice. v1: documented but not auto-applied (declare via active_buff if needed).

Psychic Spark.notes: Psychic Missiles: shoot an additional dart when casting Magic Missile (+1 projectile). Engine: catalog.MULTISOURCE_SPELL_PATCHES['Magic Missile'].projectiles_at_base could be bumped, but this is item-conditional; declare by setting action count=4 when Psychic Spark equipped.

Spellmight Gloves.notes: Spellmight: spell attack roll -5, +1d8 damage (spell-side GWM). Engine: attack_modifier on spell attacks; damage_bonus_dice models the die.

Gloves of The Duellist.notes: +2 melee weapon Attack rolls when only main hand held, off hand empty.

Gauntlets of the Warmaster.notes: Attack rolls +1; manoeuvre save disadvantage not modelled.

Dark Justiciar Gauntlets.notes: Umbral Attack: weapon attacks deal +1d4 Necrotic. (Uncommon variant.)

Gloves of Uninhibited Kushigo.notes: +1d4 damage with Throw Attacks and Improvised Weapons. Type inherits weapon.

Scabby Pugilist Circlet.notes: +2 weapon/unarmed damage while surrounded by 2+ foes. condition surrounded (build flag).

Ring of Arcane Synergy.notes: Arcane Synergy (after dealing cantrip damage): weapon attacks add spellcasting modifier. condition arcane_synergy_active (build flag).

Risky Ring.notes: Risky Attack: Advantage on Attack Rolls, Disadvantage on Saving Throws. Engine: force_advantage flag -> attack advantage (save disadvantage not modelled).

Shade-Slayer Cloak.notes: Stealthy Critical: while Hiding, crit threshold -1. condition attacker_hiding (build flag).

Covert Cowl.notes: Covert Critical: while obscured, crit threshold -1. condition attacker_obscured (build flag).

Spineshudder Amulet.notes: Crackling Resonance: ranged spell attack inflicts 2 turns Reverberation. Engine: on hit, add Reverberation to target; end_of_turn settles 5-stack 1d4 Thunder DRS.

Gloves of Belligerent Skies.notes: Thunderous Conversion: Thunder/Lightning/Radiant damage inflicts 2 Reverberation. Engine: on spell hit, stack Reverberation.

Thunderskin Cloak.notes: Dazing Echo: a Reverberation creature dealing damage inflicts more Reverberation. Simplified: +1 stack on spell hit.

Winter's Clutches.notes: Cold damage inflicts 2 Encrusted with Frost. Engine: on cold spell hit, stack Encrusted; 7-stack triggers Frozen+1d4 Cold DRS at end_of_turn.

Ichorous Gloves.notes: Acid damage inflicts Noxious Fumes (poison cloud condition). Simplified: not a damage-relevant condition for end_of_turn; flagged for completeness.

Braindrain Gloves.notes: Psychic damage inflicts Mental Fatigue (save penalty). Not damage-relevant directly; flagged.

Luminous Gloves.notes: Radiant damage inflicts 2 Radiating Orb (target attack disadvantage). Defensive debuff; flagged.

Coruscation Ring.notes: Spell damage while illuminated inflicts Radiating Orb. Flagged.

Snowburst Ring.notes: Cold damage creates ice surface; DEX save vs spell DC or Prone. Engine: on cold spell hit, inflict Prone (build settles advantage_vs_melee). Simplified: no save, flag inflict.

Hat of Fire Acuity.notes: Fire Acuity: dealing Fire damage grants Arcane Acuity (+1 spell attack & spell save DC per turn). Engine: modelled via active_buff Arcane Acuity when build declares it active.

Hat of Storm Scion's Power.notes: Thunderous Acuity: Thunder damage grants Arcane Acuity.

Helmet of Arcane Acuity.notes: Battle Acuity: weapon attack damage grants Arcane Acuity.

Arcane Acuity.notes: Arcane Acuity condition: +1 spell Attack Rolls and +1 spell save DC per remaining turn. Declare as active_buff when active. Reduces by 2 when taking damage (not modelled).
